lore.grey_wolf.name: Grey wolf
lore.grey_wolf.summary: A wolf that hunts the town woods in winter.

quote.text: In the woods east of town there are grey wolves.

hooks.idea: A hungry pack drives hunters out of the woods.

lore.mirror_spirit.name: Mirror spirit
lore.mirror_spirit.summary: A spirit that shows travellers their own fears.

quote.text: Who looks into it sees what they dread.

lore.rain_saying.name: Rain saying
lore.rain_saying.summary: Swallows flying low mean rain by nightfall.
